base_weights: Unchanged from ../chase-benchmark/h3-weights.json (Ref2VA pruned Q4_K_M, Qwen3-VL 32B Q4_K_M, video VAE fp16, Ref2V Turbo 4-step v0.1)

files.shift_source: INFERRED, not confirmed. lightx2v's Ref2VA example workflow (ModelTC/Minimax-H3-Turbo example_workflows/video_minimax_h3_ref2v_lightx2v_turbo.json) covers only the 4-step v0.1 adapter (shift 12/3, euler, simple, 4 steps). No source states the 8-step v1.1 768p values. lightx2v's release post for 8-step 768p Ref2V v1.0 (HF discussion #51, 3 Sep 2026) recommends 8 steps, video shift 12, audio shift 3, Euler. The v1.1 release post (HF discussion #57, 20 Oct 2026) recommends video shift 6 for the new adapters and says 'This recommendation applies to FL2V, not REF2V.' A user question there asking whether Ref2V 8-step v1.1 is 12/3 was unanswered on 27 Nov 2026. The embedded base_model metadata names the FL2VA checkpoint; a user queried the same field on the v1.0 file (discussion #51) without an answer.

files.choice_note: Comfy's Fun ControlNet template names only the int8_convrot build, which relies on CUDA kernels. This is the bf16 build of the same (non-2.0) union patch. The template uses strength 1, start 0, end 1, CFG 1 and 20 steps (4 with the Ref2V Turbo v0.1 LoRA).
